messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

You will be given a piece of text and a list of relational triples in the format of [Subject, Relation, Object] extracted from the text. For each relation present in the triples, your task is to write a description to express the meaning of the relation.

Here are some examples:
Example 1:
Text: Lipitor (atorvastatin) belongs to a group of drugs called statins. Lipitor is used together with diet to lower blood levels of "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and to reduce the risk of stroke and heart attack.
Triples: [["Lipitor", "has generic name", "atorvastatin"], ["Lipitor", "belongs to drug class", "statins"], ["Lipitor", "treats", "high LDL cholesterol"], ["Lipitor", "reduces risk of", "stroke"]]
Relations: ["has generic name", "belongs to drug class", "treats", "reduces risk of"]
Answer:
has generic name: The subject drug is known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
belongs to drug class: The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological drug class specified by the object entity.
treats: The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.
reduces risk of: The subject drug is used to lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.

Example 2:
Text: You should not use metformin if you have severe kidney disease. Tell your doctor if you have ever had liver disease. Metformin may cause lactic acidosis, a serious condition. Avoid drinking alcohol while taking metformin.
Triples: [["metformin", "contraindicated in", "severe kidney disease"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "liver disease"], ["metformin", "has serious side effect", "lactic acidosis"], ["metformin", "should be avoided with", "alcohol"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "use with caution in", "has serious side effect", "should be avoided with"]
Answer:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
use with caution in: The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
has serious side effect: The subject drug may cause the serious or dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity.
should be avoided with: Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.

Example 3:
Text: Amlodipine is available as oral tablets in strengths of 2.5 mg, 5 mg, and 10 mg. Overdose symptoms may include rapid heartbeats and fainting. Norvasc is made by Pfizer.
Triples: [["amlodipine", "has dosage form", "oral tablet"], ["amlodipine", "has strength", "2.5 mg"], ["amlodipine", "has overdose symptom", "fainting"], ["Norvasc", "manufactured by", "Pfizer"]]
Relations: ["has dosage form", "has strength", "has overdose symptom", "manufactured by"]
Answer:
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
has strength: The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
has overdose symptom: An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
manufactured by: The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.

Now please write relation descriptions given the following text and triples. Note that the description needs to be general and can be used to describe relations between other entities as well. Pay attention to the order of subject and object entities. Write exactly one line per relation in the form "relation: description" and nothing else.
Text: Triple therapy has resulted in eradication rates of greater than 95%.
The QUADRATE Study (n=405) involves quadruple therapy.
This therapy consists of 40 mg of the primary drug taken orally twice daily for 7 days.
It is administered concomitantly with bismuth subcitrate, taken four times daily.
It is also administered concomitantly with tetracycline, taken four times daily.
It includes metronidazole 200 mg taken three times daily.
It includes metronidazole 400 mg taken at bedtime.
Helicobacter Pylori eradication was achieved in 82% of patients.
Usual Adult Dose for Zollinger-Ellison Syndrome:
Parenteral: 80 mg every 12 hours, administered by 15-minute infusion.
Daily doses higher than 240 mg administered in equally divided doses by 15-minute infusion have not been studied.
Doses administered for more than 6 days have not been studied.
Oral: 40 mg twice daily, to a maximum of 240 mg per day.
Some patients have received treatment with pantoprazole for more than 2 years.
Usual Adult Dose for Stress Ulcer Prophylaxis:
The study included 21 participants.
Triples: [["Triple therapy", "has eradication rate", "greater than 95%"], ["QUADRATE Study", "involves", "quadruple therapy"], ["quadruple therapy", "consists of", "40 mg of primary drug"], ["primary drug", "administered via", "oral"], ["primary drug", "has administration frequency", "twice daily"], ["primary drug", "has duration", "7 days"], ["primary drug", "administered concomitantly with", "bismuth subcitrate"], ["bismuth subcitrate", "has administration frequency", "four times daily"], ["primary drug", "administered concomitantly with", "tetracycline"], ["tetracycline", "has administration frequency", "four times daily"], ["quadruple therapy", "includes", "metronidazole 200 mg"], ["metronidazole 200 mg", "has administration frequency", "three times daily"], ["quadruple therapy", "includes", "metronidazole 400 mg"], ["metronidazole 400 mg", "has administration frequency", "at bedtime"], ["quadruple therapy", "has eradication rate", "82%"], ["Zollinger-Ellison Syndrome", "has usual adult dose", "80 mg every 12 hours"], ["80 mg every 12 hours", "administered via", "parenteral"], ["80 mg every 12 hours", "has administration method", "15-minute infusion"], ["Zollinger-Ellison Syndrome", "has usual adult dose", "40 mg twice daily"], ["40 mg twice daily", "has maximum daily dose", "240 mg per day"], ["Zollinger-Ellison Syndrome", "has dose note", "daily doses higher than 240 mg administered in equally divided doses by 15-minute infusion have not been studied"], ["Zollinger-Ellison Syndrome", "has dose note", "doses administered for more than 6 days have not been studied"], ["Zollinger-Ellison Syndrome", "has dose note", "some patients have received treatment with pantoprazole for more than 2 years"], ["Stress Ulcer Prophylaxis", "has usual adult dose", "study included 21 participants"]]
Relations: ["administered concomitantly with", "administered via", "consists of", "has administration frequency", "has administration method", "has dose note", "has duration", "has eradication rate", "has maximum daily dose", "has usual adult dose", "includes", "involves"]
Answer:

completion:
administered concomitantly with: The subject drug is given at the same time as the substance or drug specified by the object entity.  
administered via: The subject dose or regimen is delivered through the route specified by the object entity.  
consists of: The subject therapy or regimen includes the component specified by the object entity.  
has administration frequency: The subject drug or regimen is taken at the frequency specified by the object entity.  
has administration method: The subject dose or regimen is administered using the method specified by the object entity.  
has dose note: The subject condition or regimen has additional information or caution related to the object entity.  
has duration: The subject drug or regimen is taken for the duration specified by the object entity.  
has eradication rate: The subject therapy achieves the specified rate of eradication of the target condition.  
has maximum daily dose: The subject regimen has a maximum daily dose specified by the object entity.  
has usual adult dose: The subject condition or regimen has a standard dose for adults specified by the object entity.  
includes: The subject therapy or regimen contains the component specified by the object entity.  
involves: The subject study or regimen includes the element specified by the object entity.
